snippet.title: Heartspell: Horizon Academy - Accessibility Trailer - Access-Ability Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Match gems, level up, and date wizards in this match-3 visual novel with a lot of heart and a little spice. Form deep relationships with faeries, sirens and werewolves, each with their own endearing personalities and challenges. Make choices that affect your relationships, and their destinies.
